correctness.solutions: Original native worker verifies every returned solution by applying it and comparing to NISSY_SOLVED_CUBE

resourceObservations.rssSampling: Manual ps samples; not a measured high-water mark. Concurrent RSS sums double-count shared table pages.
resourceObservations.measuredPeakMethod: /usr/bin/time -l, maximum resident set size, compiler-options comparison
